mai.text: Milana Premium is more than a factory — it is an intelligent production ecosystem of a new generation. Technology controls every stage: from market analysis and collection development to cutting, sewing, quality control and sales planning.
mai.m1d: The main catalog includes women’s homewear, loungewear, pajamas, tunics, shirts and similar models.
mai.m2d: Milana Man Premium models are imported into the catalog with real photos, model numbers and unit prices.
mai.m3d: Kids models are kept separate so stock and customer filters stay clear.
mai.m4d: Every model is limited edition, so availability is confirmed before order approval.
ws.text: Milana Premium is a clothing factory in Uzbekistan. We mainly produce women’s clothing, plus men’s and kids’ styles: robes, pajamas, tunics, shirts and other homewear and daily-wear models.

ws.p2d: Pack holds 6 pieces, Bag holds 60 pieces

ws.p4d: delivery cost is paid by the customer
faq.note: Exact price, availability, payment and order details are confirmed by the manager because products are limited edition.
faq.a1: Our address is Uzbekistan, Andijan, Qoratut 605. We are about 500 meters from Andijan airport.
faq.q2: Do you have a phone number?
faq.a3: The manager confirms the exact price. Sales are mainly wholesale. One bag is usually around 400–500 USD.
faq.a4: Yes, we can send the catalog. Tell us if you want to cooperate with Milana Premium.
faq.q5: Can I buy single pieces or packs?
faq.a5: Sales are mainly wholesale. Single-piece or pack orders are agreed with the manager.
faq.a6: Minimum order: at least one bag from one model. Standard calculation is 60 clothes in one bag.
faq.a7: Yes, we ship by post or Cargo. Delivery cost is paid by the customer. We provide the Cargo contact number so you can agree the details with them.
faq.a8: The manager explains payment methods and confirms the order details: +998 50 155 10 10.
faq.q9: What happens if there is a defect?
faq.a9: If a factory defect is found, the factory pays for it or sends replacement goods.
faq.a10: Our products are limited edition, so availability should be checked in advance.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.lead: These operating terms are a practical draft for the Milana Premium website and mobile apps. Final public wording should be reviewed by a qualified lawyer before launch.
terms.companyText: Milana Premium sells clothing through website, mobile app, and manager-assisted channels. Product availability, final payment method, cargo route, and dispatch timing are confirmed by a manager before shipment.
terms.accountsText: Registration is intentionally simple. Business and individual customers provide the same basic contact information. Orders use the Milana package rule: a pack for 6 pieces or a bag for 60 pieces.
terms.ordersText: Orders use the Milana package rule: 1 pack equals 6 pieces, typically 1 per size; 1 bag equals 60 pieces, typically 10 per size. Online payment integration is not final; orders are accepted with pending payment status until manager confirmation.
terms.reviewsText: Only verified purchasers may submit reviews. Reviews can include rating, comment, and optional photo, and are published after moderation.
terms.dataText: Account, order, wishlist, review, and support-chat data are used to process orders and improve customer service. Customers can request help through the support page, chat widget, WhatsApp, or Telegram.
ordering.title: How Ordering Works
ordering.step1Text: Customers choose pack or bag quantities and provide delivery details for manager confirmation.
ordering.step2Text: A pack contains 6 pieces with 1 per size. A bag contains 60 pieces with 10 per size.
ordering.step3Text: Stock, exact payment, and delivery route are confirmed by a Milana manager before dispatch.
ordering.step4Text: Payment is currently manager-confirmed. Regional delivery time is usually 1-5 business days after dispatch, depending on cargo route.
ordering.step5Text: Your account order history shows new, processing, shipped, done, or cancelled status. Tracking number can be added by admin.
